This article explains every public `SkosmosR` function with a concrete usage
pattern. Network examples are shown but not executed while the vignette is
built, so package documentation does not depend on third-party service uptime.

```{r setup, eval=FALSE}
library(SkosmosR)
finto <- skosmos_client("https://api.finto.fi/rest/v1/")
```

## Client and low-level access

### `skosmos_client()`

Create one client per Skosmos REST API. Change only the API base URL to use a
different provider.

```{r client, eval=FALSE}
finto <- skosmos_client("https://api.finto.fi/rest/v1/")
ilc <- skosmos_client(
  "https://vocabs.ilc4clarin.ilc.cnr.it/skosmos/rest/v1/"
)
```

### `skosmos_ping()`

Check whether the endpoint responds to a vocabulary-list request.

```{r ping, eval=FALSE}
skosmos_ping(finto)
```

### `skosmos_request()`

Use the low-level API when you need the original JSON or a route that is not
wrapped by a high-level helper.

```{r request, eval=FALSE}
raw <- skosmos_request(
  finto,
  "vocabularies",
  query = list(lang = "en")
)
str(raw)
```

## Vocabulary discovery and metadata

### `skosmos_vocabularies()`

List vocabularies. The `id` column is especially important because that value
is used as `vocid` in most vocabulary-specific functions.

```{r vocabularies, eval=FALSE}
vocabs <- skosmos_vocabularies(finto, lang = "en")
vocabs
vocabs$id
```

### `skosmos_vocabulary()`

Retrieve metadata for one vocabulary.

```{r vocabulary, eval=FALSE}
skosmos_vocabulary(finto, vocid = "yso", lang = "en")

# Generic pattern: select one ID from discovery results.
vocid <- vocabs$id[1]
skosmos_vocabulary(finto, vocid, lang = "en")
```

### `skosmos_types()`

List available resource types globally or for one vocabulary.

```{r types, eval=FALSE}
skosmos_types(finto, lang = "en")
skosmos_types(finto, lang = "en", vocid = "yso")
```

### `skosmos_groups()`

List concept groups or collections in a vocabulary. An empty tibble is valid if
the vocabulary does not define groups.

```{r groups, eval=FALSE}
groups <- skosmos_groups(finto, vocid = "yso", lang = "en")
groups
```

### `skosmos_top_concepts()`

Return concepts at the top of the vocabulary hierarchy.

```{r top-concepts, eval=FALSE}
skosmos_top_concepts(finto, vocid = "yso", lang = "en")
```

## Searching and lookup

### `skosmos_search()`

Search across all vocabularies or restrict the search using `vocabs`.

```{r search, eval=FALSE}
skosmos_search(
  finto,
  query = "forest",
  vocabs = "yso",
  lang = "en",
  maxhits = 10
)
```

### `skosmos_vocabulary_search()`

Search within exactly one vocabulary.

```{r vocabulary-search, eval=FALSE}
skosmos_vocabulary_search(
  finto,
  vocid = "yso",
  query = "forest",
  lang = "en",
  maxhits = 10
)
```

### `skosmos_lookup()`

Resolve a label to a concept in one vocabulary.

```{r lookup, eval=FALSE}
skosmos_lookup(finto, vocid = "yso", label = "cat", lang = "en")
```

### `skosmos_label_uri()`

Get a label directly from a URI without first specifying a vocabulary.

```{r label-uri, eval=FALSE}
skosmos_label_uri(
  finto,
  uri = "http://www.yso.fi/onto/yso/p7160",
  lang = "en"
)
```

## Alphabetical browsing and statistics

### `skosmos_index_letters()` and `skosmos_index()`

First request valid index letters, then browse one letter.

```{r index, eval=FALSE}
letters <- skosmos_index_letters(finto, "yso", lang = "en")
letters
skosmos_index(finto, "yso", letter = "A", lang = "en")
```

### `skosmos_vocabulary_statistics()`

```{r vocabulary-statistics, eval=FALSE}
skosmos_vocabulary_statistics(finto, "yso", lang = "en")
```

### `skosmos_label_statistics()`

```{r label-statistics, eval=FALSE}
skosmos_label_statistics(finto, "yso", lang = "en")
```

### `skosmos_new_concepts()` and `skosmos_modified_concepts()`

These routes depend on server and vocabulary support.

```{r changed, eval=FALSE}
skosmos_new_concepts(finto, "yso", lang = "en", limit = 20)
skosmos_modified_concepts(finto, "yso", lang = "en", limit = 20)
```

## Concept handles and semantic relationships

Create the concept handle once and reuse it for all relationship calls.

```{r concept-handle, eval=FALSE}
cosmology <- skosmos_concept(
  finto,
  vocid = "yso",
  uri = "http://www.yso.fi/onto/yso/p7160"
)
cosmology
```

### `skosmos_label()`

```{r label, eval=FALSE}
skosmos_label(cosmology, lang = "en")
```

### `skosmos_broader()` and `skosmos_broader_transitive()`

Direct broader concepts versus all ancestors.

```{r broader, eval=FALSE}
skosmos_broader(cosmology, lang = "en")
skosmos_broader_transitive(cosmology, lang = "en", limit = 20)
```

### `skosmos_narrower()` and `skosmos_narrower_transitive()`

Direct narrower concepts versus all descendants.

```{r narrower, eval=FALSE}
skosmos_narrower(cosmology, lang = "en")
skosmos_narrower_transitive(cosmology, lang = "en", limit = 20)
```

### `skosmos_related()`

```{r related, eval=FALSE}
skosmos_related(cosmology, lang = "en")
```

### `skosmos_children()`

```{r children, eval=FALSE}
skosmos_children(cosmology, lang = "en")
```

### `skosmos_hierarchy()`

Hierarchy responses can be nested, so nested branches are preserved as tibble
list-columns.

```{r hierarchy, eval=FALSE}
skosmos_hierarchy(cosmology, lang = "en")
```

### `skosmos_mappings()`

```{r mappings, eval=FALSE}
skosmos_mappings(cosmology, lang = "en")
```

### `skosmos_group_members()`

Use a real group URI returned by `skosmos_groups()`.

```{r group-members, eval=FALSE}
groups <- skosmos_groups(finto, "yso", lang = "en")

# Check the returned columns, then select a real group URI.
group_uri <- groups$uri[1]
group <- skosmos_concept(finto, "yso", group_uri)
skosmos_group_members(group, lang = "en")
```

## RDF access

### `skosmos_data()`

Retrieve RDF for a concept/resource or vocabulary.

```{r data, eval=FALSE}
ttl <- skosmos_data(
  finto,
  uri = "http://www.yso.fi/onto/yso/p7160",
  vocid = "yso",
  format = "text/turtle"
)
```

### `skosmos_vocabulary_data()`

```{r vocabulary-data, eval=FALSE}
yso_ttl <- skosmos_vocabulary_data(
  finto,
  vocid = "yso",
  format = "text/turtle"
)
```

### `skosmos_concept_data()`

```{r concept-data, eval=FALSE}
skosmos_concept_data(cosmology, format = "application/ld+json")
```

### `skosmos_rdf()`

Parse RDF with the optional `rdflib` package.

```{r rdf, eval=FALSE}
graph <- skosmos_rdf(
  finto,
  uri = "http://www.yso.fi/onto/yso/p7160",
  vocid = "yso",
  format = "text/turtle",
  rdf_format = "turtle"
)
```

## Public instance helpers

### `skosmos_instances()`

```{r instances, eval=FALSE}
instances <- skosmos_instances()
instances
```

### `skosmos_test_instance()`

```{r test-instance, eval=FALSE}
skosmos_test_instance("https://api.finto.fi/rest/v1/")
```

### `skosmos_test_registry()`

```{r test-registry, eval=FALSE}
results <- skosmos_test_registry()
results
results[!results$ok, ]
```

## The same interface with other Skosmos APIs

The functions above are provider-independent. These clients can be substituted
for `finto` in the examples where the selected vocabulary supports the route.

```{r other-clients, eval=FALSE}
unesco <- skosmos_client("https://vocabularies.unesco.org/rest/v1/")
agrovoc <- skosmos_client("https://agrovoc.fao.org/browse/rest/v1/")
nffa <- skosmos_client("https://metarepo.nffa.eu/skosmos/rest/v1/")
metno <- skosmos_client("https://vocab.met.no/rest/v1/")
ilc <- skosmos_client(
  "https://vocabs.ilc4clarin.ilc.cnr.it/skosmos/rest/v1/"
)
clarin <- skosmos_client("https://vocabularies.clarin.eu/clavas/rest/v1/")
loterre <- skosmos_client("https://skosmos.loterre.fr/rest/v1/")
actris <- skosmos_client(
  "https://vocabulary.actris.nilu.no/skosmos/rest/v1/"
)
zpid <- skosmos_client("https://vocabs.leibniz-psychology.org/rest/v1/")
uio <- skosmos_client("https://data.ub.uio.no/skosmos/rest/v1/")
dharc <- skosmos_client("https://lab.dharc.unibo.it/skosmos/rest/v1/")

# Discovery is the safest first call on every server.
skosmos_vocabularies(unesco, "en")
skosmos_vocabularies(agrovoc, "en")
skosmos_vocabularies(nffa, "en")
skosmos_vocabularies(metno, "en")
skosmos_vocabularies(ilc, "en")
skosmos_vocabularies(clarin, "en")
skosmos_vocabularies(loterre, "en")
skosmos_vocabularies(actris, "en")
skosmos_vocabularies(zpid, "en")
skosmos_vocabularies(uio, "en")
skosmos_vocabularies(dharc, "en")
```
